description: Show which MCP servers and skills each BB machine actually has, then bring them to one catalogue and one canon. A matrix marks present, missing, and drifted configs; new servers wait for adopt, keep-local, or hide. Sync adds what is missing and never deletes on its own. The Skills tab treats ~/.agents/skills as a git canon, with fan-out into CLI homes and a version archive. Writes back up each config first; loopback paths and local secrets stay on that machine. Optional MetaMCP listing needs that gateway's API key.
